The *Sanidassanaduka* (Patthana 14.8) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. The title designates the dyad (*duka*) dealing with states that are visible (*sanidassana*), investigated in terms of the conditional relations that form the analytical framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
